views.markdown: ## See your sleep time remaining, right in Clock.
Live countdowns beneath your alarm labels. See the hours, minutes and seconds at a glance.
Available to try on iOS/iPadOS 16 through 26 with a compatible rootless jailbreak. No Dopamine-only requirement. Tested configurations are listed separately; other combinations need testing.

screenshots.accessibilityText: Clock Alarms showing enabled 6:10 AM and 5:20 PM countdowns and a gray disabled 11:45 AM countdown preview.

views.markdown: Appears automatically in Clock. No configuration needed.
An independent implementation by **0chium**, inspired by **AlarmTime by P2KDev**. Free and MIT licensed.
Available to try on iOS/iPadOS 16 through 26 with a compatible rootless jailbreak. No Dopamine-only requirement. Tested configurations are listed separately; other combinations need testing.

**iPhone 14 Pro** — iOS 16.2 (20C65), Sleep Left 0.1.3 (owner-tested)

**iPhone 14 Pro** — iOS 17.0 (21A329)

**iPhone 11 Pro Max** — iOS 18.3.2 (22D82)

**iPhone SE (2nd generation)** — iOS 26.0.1 (23A355)

Owner reports Sleep Left 0.1.3 working on iPhone 14 Pro, iOS 16.2 (20C65). The owner previously reported 0.1.1 working on iPhone SE (2nd generation), iOS 26.0.1 (23A355). The iOS 17.0 and 18.3.2 functional tests used the alpha; version 0.1.2 was not separately device-tested. Version 0.1.3 adds iOS 16 admission without changing countdown behavior. Other combinations remain unverified.

Sleep/Wake Up alarms are not included. Disabled alarms show a countdown preview and remain off. Countdown units are English.

Other configurations, including RootHide, are unverified. All versions within iOS/iPadOS 16–26 are allowed to try. Use one alarm-countdown tweak at a time.

Allows installation and initialization on iOS/iPadOS 16–26. No changes to countdown behavior or existing runtime checks. Owner confirms 0.1.3 working on iPhone 14 Pro / iOS 16.2; other configurations remain unverified.

Allows all minor and patch versions within iOS/iPadOS 16–26. Retains native method/type and layout checks, countdown behavior, artwork and credits. Earlier test results are preserved; this new build is not device-tested.
Enables installation and initialization on exactly iOS 26.0.1, now owner-tested on iPhone SE (2nd generation). Countdown behavior and existing interface/layout checks are unchanged.
First public release. Live alarm countdowns in Clock, with your existing labels and controls.
